Theory often cannot give the [bias](estimation.qmd#def-bias), [variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) or coverage of an [estimator](estimation.qmd#def-estimator)
when the estimator or the data [distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable) is complicated.
A [simulation study](#def-simulation-study) measures the same properties for any estimator a computer can run.
It generates many [data sets](model-validation.qmd#def-data-set) from a distribution whose parameters are known,
applies the estimator to each,
and summarizes the results.

This page defines the parts of a [simulation study](#def-simulation-study).
